#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll mod = 998244353;
const int MAXN = 400000;

ll fact[MAXN+1];
ll invFact[MAXN+1];

ll mul(ll x, ll y) {
    ll res = (x * y) % mod;
    if (res < 0) res += mod;
    return res;
}

ll pow_mod(ll x, ll y) {
    if (y < 0) return 0;
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    if (y % 2 == 1) return mul(x, pow_mod(x, y-1));
    ll root = pow_mod(x, y/2);
    return mul(root, root);
}

ll div_mod(ll x, ll y) {
    return mul(x, pow_mod(y, mod-2));
}

void preFact(int n) {
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        fact[i+1] = mul(i+1, fact[i]);
    }
    invFact[n] = div_mod(1, fact[n]);
    for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; i--) {
        invFact[i] = mul(invFact[i+1], i+1);
    }
}

ll cmb(int a, int b) {
    if (a < b) return 0;
    ll af = fact[a];
    ll bf = invFact[b];
    ll abf = invFact[a-b];
    return mul(mul(af, bf), abf);
}

// Fast input
static char inbuf[1024];
static int lenbuf = 0, ptrbuf = 0;

static int readByte() {
    if (lenbuf == -1) return -1;
    if (ptrbuf >= lenbuf) {
        ptrbuf = 0;
        lenbuf = (int)fread(inbuf, 1, 1024, stdin);
        if (lenbuf <= 0) return -1;
    }
    return inbuf[ptrbuf++];
}

static bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
    return !(c >= 33 && c <= 126);
}

static int skip() {
    int b;
    while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && isSpaceChar(b));
    return b;
}

static int ni() {
    int num = 0, b;
    bool minus = false;
    while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && !((b >= '0' && b <= '9') || b == '-'));
    if (b == '-') {
        minus = true;
        b = readByte();
    }
    while (true) {
        if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
        } else {
            return minus ? -num : num;
        }
        b = readByte();
    }
}

static ll nl() {
    ll num = 0;
    int b;
    bool minus = false;
    while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && !((b >= '0' && b <= '9') || b == '-'));
    if (b == '-') {
        minus = true;
        b = readByte();
    }
    while (true) {
        if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
            num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
        } else {
            return minus ? -num : num;
        }
        b = readByte();
    }
}

void solve() {
    int n = ni();
    ll tmp = nl();
    if (n <= tmp) {
        printf("0\n");
        return;
    }
    int k = (int)tmp;
    preFact(400000);
    ll ans = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    int limit = n - k;
    int i = 1;
    while (i <= limit) {
        ll term = mul(cmb(limit, i), pow_mod(i, n));
        if (sign == 1) {
            ans = (ans + term) % mod;
        } else {
            ans = (ans - term + mod) % mod;
        }
        sign = -sign;
        i++;
    }
    ll t = cmb(n, n - k);
    ans = mul(ans, t);
    if (k != 0) ans = mul(ans, 2);
    if (ans < 0) ans += mod;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
